title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the current I between the spheres.

title: Electric Field Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the electric field E in terms of the current I and the constant K.

title: Potential Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the potential difference V using the electric field.

title: Correct Units
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that the units of the final answer for current I are consistent with amperes.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes when integrating to find the potential difference.

title: Substitution Accuracy
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that substitutions made in the equations are correct and consistent.
